name: AI prediction of total knee replacement
note: Anchor: Demanse 2026, 20-year insurance records from Israel. Companions: Salman 2026 (routine hospital radiographs, internal test only) and Leung 2020 (OAI research cohort), the contrast case.
question: Has an AI model that predicts future total knee replacement in knee osteoarthritis been validated on real clinical data rather than research cohorts?
gap: No AI model that predicts total knee replacement has been externally validated on routine clinical data (health records, insurance claims, or hospital imaging); models are built and tested on research cohorts such as OAI and MOST.
disproof: A paper whose own study trains or tests a TKR prediction model on routine clinical data and evaluates it on patients from a different hospital, health system, or time period, with TKR as the outcome.
query: ("total knee replacement" OR "total knee arthroplasty") AND ("machine learning" OR "deep learning" OR "artificial intelligence") AND predict* AND osteoarthritis
